verdict.rationale: Docs confirm card issuance is API-driven (create a paymentInstrument specifying virtual or physical) and that cardholders can later reveal PAN/CVC/expiry via SDK, but there is no evidence the creation call itself returns PAN/CVV/expiry immediately, nor any mention of a self-serve sandbox-to-live path without a sales/commercial onboarding process (which Adyen's licensing language even implies is needed). missing for 10: explicit API response showing PAN/CVV/expiry returned at issuance, and evidence of self-serve sandbox-to-production activation without a sales cycle.
